Read and follow the [portable developer bootstrap prompt](../../developer-onboarding/bootstrap.prompt.md)
and [project rules](../../AGENTS.md).

Begin with Phase 1 only: inspect the repository and report verified, missing,
blocked, or deferred capabilities for the developer's role. Ask before installations,
configuration edits, tracker initialization, or model downloads. Do not implement the app.
